title: Towards Accurate UAV Image Perception: Guiding Vision-Language Models with Stronger Task Prompts
abstract: arXiv:2512.07302v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: UAV image perception with VLMs aims to identify and localize targets based on semantic and spatial task prompts. However, small, densely distributed objects and cluttered backgrounds hinder these tasks, particularly when concise prompts provide insufficient guidance. Although task-specific fine-tuning improves image-text alignment, it requires large-scale annotations and model-specific updates, increasing adaptation costs across models and tasks. To address this, we propose AerialVP, a task-adaptive, training-free agent that adapts VLMs through prompt enhancement rather than parameter optimization. AerialVP dynamically adapts its enhancement strategy to the original prompt's specificity, selectively incorporating image-derived semantics, spatial positions, and object relationships. These cues provide discriminative descriptions and spatial constraints, leveraging VLMs' pretrained alignment and reasoning capabilities to improve

translated_title: 面向精准无人机图像感知：利用更强的任务提示引导视觉-语言模型
translated_abstract: 基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的无人机图像感知旨在根据语义和空间任务提示来识别和定位目标。然而，小而密集分布的物体以及杂乱的背景阻碍了这些任务的执行，尤其是当简洁的提示所提供的引导不足时。尽管针对特定任务的微调能够改善图文对齐，但它需要大规模标注和针对特定模型的更新，增加了跨模型和跨任务的适配成本。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AerialVP，这是一个任务自适应、无需训练的智能体，它通过提示增强而非参数优化来适配VLM。AerialVP根据原始提示的具体程度动态调整其增强策略，选择性地融入从图像中提取的语义信息、空间位置和物体关系。这些线索提供了具有判别性的描述和空间约束，借助VLM预训练的对齐与推理能力来提升感知性能。
tldr: 该论文提出无需训练的任务自适应智能体AerialVP，通过根据提示具体程度动态融入图像语义、空间位置和物体关系的提示增强策略，摆脱对微调和大规模标注的依赖，从而提升视觉-语言模型在无人机图像感知中的目标识别与定位精度。
en_tdlr: AerialVP is a training-free, task-adaptive agent that enhances task prompts by selectively incorporating image-derived semantics, spatial positions, and object relationships, improving VLM-based UAV image perception without costly fine-tuning.
